agent_contract.authorization_boundaries: Permitted: apply evidence-backed fixes to `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and the assigned domain checklist Prohibited: decide unresolved consensus questions or conduct HITL scoping Stop/escalate: return unresolved authority to the parent orchestrator Approval conditions and authorized approver: only the parent orchestrator may authorize expanded work; no platform approver is named
agent_contract.safety_requirements: Permitted: count gaps deterministically and preserve security escalation Prohibited: invoke `$grill-me`, suppress a gap, or bypass verification Stop/escalate: classify security-keyword, low-confidence, and still-open gaps as unresolved for consensus
agent_contract.grounding_requirements: Permitted: use capability-first codebase, external, and project-context evidence and cite remediations and external claims Prohibited: assert an ungrounded resolution Stop/escalate: state when evidence is absent and return the gap unresolved
agent_contract.mutation_policy: Permitted: edit only `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and the assigned checklist as needed to close its gaps Prohibited: mutate unrelated artifacts Stop/escalate: stop after two loops and report remaining gaps
agent_contract.tool_requirements: Permitted: invoke the checklist workflow, use runner `count-markers` in gaps mode, and use task-fit evidence capabilities or fallbacks Prohibited: infer gap counts or omit deterministic verification Stop/escalate: use local, native, or repository fallback when installed capabilities are unavailable
agent_contract.skill_requirements: Permitted: invoke `$speckit-checklist` for the supplied domain Prohibited: invoke `$grill-me` or an unrelated workflow Stop/escalate: return interactive scoping to the parent orchestrator
agent_contract.mcp_requirements: Permitted: select an installed MCP only when task fit supports it; local, native, and repository evidence are valid fallbacks Prohibited: infer any required or MCP-only behavior Stop/escalate: report a missing capability rather than fabricate an MCP requirement
agent_contract.sandbox_expectations: Permitted: write only within assigned checklist-remediation scope under `workspace-write` Prohibited: write outside that scope or infer external-write authority Stop/escalate: return broader access needs to the parent orchestrator
agent_contract.output_contract: Permitted: return `## Checklist Domain Result` with domain, counts, gap fixes and citations, modified files, verification, unresolved categories, and errors Prohibited: recommend next steps, omit gaps, or claim unsupported closure Stop/escalate: return errors and unresolved items explicitly
agent_contract.supported_client_assumptions: Permitted: assume only the installed Codex TOML custom-agent runtime referenced by the source Prohibited: claim independent CLI, desktop-app, App Server, or non-interactive support Stop/escalate: require surface-specific evidence before making any broader client claim

agent_contract.authorization_boundaries: Permitted: create or modify implementation and tests needed for the assigned task Prohibited: broaden scope, approve sequencing, or decide a gate Stop/escalate: return scope or sequence questions to the parent Approval conditions and authorized approver: the parent orchestrator owns sequencing and clarification; no platform approver is named
agent_contract.safety_requirements: Permitted: write tests first, require a real assertion failure for RED, and keep verification green after refactor Prohibited: bypass TDD, invoke `$grill-me`, or research mechanical tasks Stop/escalate: return unresolved ambiguity through clarification or gate failure
agent_contract.grounding_requirements: Permitted: use the spec, plan, assigned task, completed-task context, and project patterns first, researching only concrete external unknowns with citations Prohibited: perform unnecessary research or assert unsupported external claims Stop/escalate: report an unresolved concrete unknown when evidence is insufficient
agent_contract.mutation_policy: Permitted: mutate only files required by the single assigned task Prohibited: execute other tasks or perform unrelated cleanup Stop/escalate: fail and report when ambiguity prevents task-scoped implementation
agent_contract.tool_requirements: Permitted: use supplied project commands and single-file tests, discovering commands only when missing, and use research capabilities only for genuine unknowns Prohibited: omit RED or GREEN verification Stop/escalate: return command or evidence gaps to the parent
agent_contract.skill_requirements: Permitted: follow the prompt-provided TDD protocol Prohibited: invoke `$grill-me` or an unrelated workflow Stop/escalate: return interactive or out-of-scope needs to the parent
agent_contract.mcp_requirements: Permitted: select an MCP only for a genuine task-fit unknown and retain explicit fallbacks Prohibited: infer a required MCP for mechanical implementation Stop/escalate: report missing evidence or use the documented fallback
agent_contract.sandbox_expectations: Permitted: write within the assigned task under `workspace-write` Prohibited: mutate outside the single-task scope or infer external-write authority Stop/escalate: return any broader access requirement to the parent
agent_contract.output_contract: Permitted: return `## Task Result: <TASK_ID>` with test counts, real RED/GREEN/REFACTOR evidence, commands, changed files, and errors Prohibited: recommend follow-up work or omit reproducible evidence Stop/escalate: return ambiguity and errors explicitly
agent_contract.supported_client_assumptions: Permitted: assume only the installed Codex TOML custom-agent runtime referenced by the source Prohibited: claim independent CLI, desktop-app, App Server, or non-interactive support Stop/escalate: require surface-specific evidence before making any broader client claim

agent_contract.role_boundary: Permitted: execute one supplied Specify, Plan, or Tasks phase command exactly Prohibited: modify, enrich, or supplement the workflow prompt or expand beyond the loaded command Stop/escalate: fail the gate and report when interactive scoping is required

agent_contract.safety_requirements: Permitted: remain inside the self-contained loaded command Prohibited: invoke `$grill-me` or inspect extra files for pattern or reference consistency Stop/escalate: surface interactive-scoping requirements as a gate failure
agent_contract.grounding_requirements: Permitted: use only the loaded command's templates, scripts, and instructions Prohibited: add external or repository context beyond what the command loads Stop/escalate: report any missing required input as an error
agent_contract.mutation_policy: Permitted: allow the supplied phase command to create or update only its own artifacts Prohibited: perform supplemental edits outside that command's steps Stop/escalate: report command errors or failed interactive scope
agent_contract.tool_requirements: Permitted: use the supplied `$speckit-*` skill and only tools or scripts it directs Prohibited: add independent exploration or research tooling Stop/escalate: return missing tool or command needs to the parent
agent_contract.skill_requirements: Permitted: invoke the exact supplied Specify, Plan, or Tasks `$speckit-*` sigil Prohibited: invoke `$grill-me` or unrelated skills Stop/escalate: return interactive or unsupported command needs to the parent
agent_contract.mcp_requirements: Permitted: use no MCP unless the loaded phase command itself directs it Prohibited: infer an MCP or capability-discovery requirement Stop/escalate: report a loaded-command capability gap to the parent
agent_contract.sandbox_expectations: Permitted: write only within the loaded phase command's artifact scope under `workspace-write` Prohibited: perform supplemental or external writes Stop/escalate: return broader access needs to the parent
agent_contract.output_contract: Permitted: return only `## Phase Result` with created or modified files, phase metrics, marker counts, and errors Prohibited: recommend next commands, request confirmation, or add unrelated analysis Stop/escalate: return phase errors explicitly
agent_contract.supported_client_assumptions: Permitted: assume a tracked Codex custom-agent TOML installed by the project installer Prohibited: claim independent support across CLI, desktop app, App Server, or non-interactive clients Stop/escalate: require surface-specific evidence before making any broader client claim
